$description: Wave 5 (W5 Selection) component tokens for Listbox — the template for the rest of the wave (Select/Combobox/MultiSelect/RadioCards/TagInput reuse this same option-token shape). Same accent-scarcity reasoning as checkbox.json/radio.json/switch.json: the selected option's non-color cue (a checkmark glyph) uses `color.text.default`, not the scarce brand accent, because a listbox commonly renders several selected options at once (multi-select) and a single view should not read as having many 'primary action' elements (braun-flat rule 3). Option hover/focus surface reuses the existing `color.overlay.hover` alpha wash (same token Button already uses for its non-shadow hover cue) instead of a new opaque fill, so hover state composes correctly over both the default option background and the selected option's `surface.inset` background. Root border reuses `color.border.hairline` (braun-flat rule 1 — no decorative shadow on the listbox surface itself; it is not a floating layer, so no `shadow.elevation.*` here either, contrast with Popover.Content which is a floating layer per braun-flat rule 2). `section.headingText` (added for `Listbox.Section`, API review item 3) reuses `color.text.subtle` — a section heading is metadata about the group, not selectable content, so it should read quieter than `option.text` even though both sit in the same visual column.
